description: This Jupyter notebook implements a simulation-based probabilistic tsunami risk assessment for buildings: building losses are sampled from fragility and consequence models, using exposure data from OpenBuilding, to estimate loss exceedance curves and expected annual loss for single buildings and portfolios. It is published by ETRiS, the European Tsunami Risk Service, from the University of Naples Federico II; version 1.0.0 was archived on Zenodo on 9 July 2026 from the eurotsunamirisk GitHub organisation. Coverage: European coastal building portfolios for which tsunami hazard and exposure inputs exist. Access: a Python notebook from Zenodo or GitHub. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: results depend on the hazard simulations and fragility models supplied; the record describes the workflow in one sentence. Simulation uses are tsunami loss estimation for coastal buildings and portfolios, and comparing mitigation measures by expected annual loss. Related records: the RIESGOS state-dependent tsunami fragility functions and the Noto reconnaissance data.
